description: Fetch the Instagram home feed (instagram.com/) — the timeline of accounts you follow, mixed with suggested posts and ads. Every item is labeled with its source (following / suggested / ad). Returns post cards with author, caption, like/comment counts, timestamp, and media URLs; scrolls internally up to 100 items, partial=true when the feed stops producing new items. Use instagram/get-post on any item URL for full text and comments. Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100, default 20). Scrolls internally; partial=true when the feed stops producing new items.
